faq.q: How much does pressure washing cost?
faq.a: Most Coastal Crown jobs run between $250 and $8,000+, depending on the surface, the square footage, and how heavy the buildup is. A single driveway is at the low end; a full commercial lot or multi-building HOA is at the high end. Every quote is free and given in writing before we start — no surprises.

We serve all of Miami-Dade and Broward counties — from Brickell, Coral Gables, and Pinecrest up through Fort Lauderdale, Pembroke Pines, and Weston. Every call is geo-tagged by ZIP and routed to the nearest available crew.

Yes. Estimates are always free and there's no obligation. Call, text, or snap a photo of the surface and we'll give you an illustrative range up front, then confirm the exact price with a free on-site visit.

faq.q: What's the difference between soft-wash and pressure washing?
faq.a: Pressure washing uses high water pressure to blast dirt off hard surfaces like concrete driveways and sidewalks. Soft-washing uses low pressure plus surface-safe cleaning solutions to kill algae and mildew on delicate surfaces — roofs, painted siding, screens, and stucco — without damaging them. We match the method to the surface every time.

faq.q: Do you have a Spanish line?
faq.a: Sí. We're a bilingual crew and run a dedicated Spanish route — se habla español. Pick your language at the top of this page and the site and our concierge respond in it.

faq.q: Do you handle commercial and HOA properties?
faq.a: Absolutely. Storefronts, plazas, restaurants, parking garages, and full HOA communities get their own priority lines and callback SLA. We schedule off-hours where needed so we're never in your customers' way.

faq.q: Can you clean up after a storm?
faq.a: Yes — post-storm exterior cleanup is one of our specialties, and Coastal Crown is an enrolled vendor on the WIN storm-dispatch network. When a South Florida storm passes, cleanup leads route straight to the nearest crew for a fast quote and same-week service.
